explanation: The theorem is about geodesic lines, extended geodesic segments and open/closed left half-planes in the hyperbolic upper half-plane. All of these are the library's own definitions (geodesicLine, extGeodesicSegment, leftHalfPlane, extClosedLeftHalfPlane, IsGeodesicFromTo). I searched Mathlib's Analysis/Complex/UpperHalfPlane directory for "geodesic" and "leftHalfPlane". The only hit was a docstring in FixedPoints.lean about a geodesic line of fixed points. It is not related to this statement: Mathlib has no theory of hyperbolic geodesic segments or half-planes. The proof only uses the library's own lemmas.
